assertions: Different source books and independent BookCopyService instances target one new destination
Both parties pass final path prechecks before Barrier release; no lock or sleep serializes publication
Exactly one result reports success; the other is IOException
Final BookId equals the successful caller's returned BookInfo
Final bytes equal the hash captured by the successful caller when Execute returned
Losing cleanup leaves winner's destination in place and both sources byte-unchanged
Both operation-owned temporary directories are empty and removed
ownership: Unix ready staging link remains owned by its CopyWorkspace after publication; cleanup unlinks only that staging name, never the destination. Windows successful move leaves no ready name.
fallback: No replacing rename, File.Copy, in-process lock, or sleep fallback. Unsupported Unix hard links fail safely.

windows: Not executed. Windows branch follows fixed runtime MoveFileEx without MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING; Unix results are not Windows validation.
